name: Pakistan Affairs · Reform Movements & Pakistan Movement (1857–1947)
title: Pakistan Affairs · Reform Movements & Pakistan Movement (1857–1947)
subtitle: Practice bank topic · 96 MCQs
answerKeyNote: Practice answer key (not an official FPSC key). Keys were cross-checked and corrected where needed; items marked Low confidence are noted in the explanation.
source: https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies (topic chapters: history, constitution, geography, economy, foreign relations, culture)

questions.text: In connection with land reforms the Punjab tenancy act was passed in _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1887. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: The renowned author of the Spirit of Islam and a Short History of the Saracens was __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Syed Ameer Ali. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: Nawab Sir Salimullah Khan was President of Bengal Musilm Leage in _____.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: Salimullah led the Eastern Bengal & Assam provincial League from its formation (c.1906–07); key retained. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: The first issue of Maualana Abul Kalam Azad’s ‘Al Hilal’ came out on 13 July ______.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1912. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: At the annual session of Anjuman Hamayat Islam in 1911 Iqbal’s poem was recited, poetically called _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: Shikwa. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: Sir sultan Muhammad shah, the Agha khan headed the historic Simla deputation which successfully presented Muslim demands on 01, October 1906 before ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Lord Minto. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: Quaid-e-Azam said in an interview on any hope of India and Pakistan coming to a peaceful settlement provided the Indian government shed the superiority complex and deal with Pakistan on an equal footing given to special correspondent from __________.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: obscure interview attribution retained from the CSS key. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: Indian Khilafat Deputation visited England to put their views before LIyod George in ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1920. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: The Lucknow Pact was conceived by ____________.
questions.explanation: Answer: None of these. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: Sir Sikandar Hayat Khan was leader of _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Unionist Party. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: In 1917 Kheiri Brothers suggested a plan of partition of India in conference of the Socialist International held in _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: Stockholm. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: On 7th August, Muhammad Ali Jinnah left India for the last time and flew to _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Karachi. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: From 1858 upto about 1870 nearly all British Politicians, authors blamed the Muslims for __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Disloyalty. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: “The Millat and Menace of Indianism” is written by ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Ch. Rehmat Ali. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: Who was first appointed Nazim of Nadva-ul-ulema in 1883?
questions.explanation: Note: the Nadwat-ul-Ulema was founded in 1893–94 (the year 1883 in the stem appears to be a typo in the paper); Maulana Muhammad Ali Mongiri was its first Nazim. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: The resolution for formation of All-Indian Muslim League was passed at the meeting of All India Educational Conference (1906) and was moved by __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Nawab Salimullah. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: The demand of separate electorate for Indian Muslims was first accepted in the Act of _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1909. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: The provincial governments of Congress resigned and All-India Muslim League as a mark of relief observed the “Day of Deliverance” on _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 22 Dec. 1939. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: The Lahore Resolution was amended and Pakistan was made an integral part of League’s objective. The amendment was made in the Annual session (1941) of All India Muslim League, which was held at ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Madras. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: Ch. Rahmat Ali, the architect of the name of Pakistan, died on _____.
questions.explanation: Answer: None of these. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: Who has written the book entitled “The Making of Pakistan”?
questions.explanation: Correct fact: K.K.Aziz. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: Anjuman-e-Islamia Punjab was founded for the renaissance of Islam in the year ______.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: founding year as per CSS solutions. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.explanation: Answer: Sultan Muhammad Shah (Aga Khan III). Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Who divided Bengal into East and West Bengal in July 1905?
questions.explanation: Answer: Lord Curzon. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Dyarchy was first introduced in the Act of ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1919. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: All India Muslim League observed the “Direct Action Day” on ___________.

questions.text: Who is the author of “Hunter par Hunter”?

questions.text: Who drafted “Wardha Scheme” under the guidance of Ghandi?

questions.text: Who initiated the cult of Shivaji against the Muslims of India?
questions.explanation: Answer: Bal Ganga Dher Tilak. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: When the congress ministries resigned from their offices?
questions.explanation: Answer: Oct-Nov 1939. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Who negotiated with cabinet mission (1946) on behalf of All India National Congress?
questions.explanation: Answer: A.K.Azad. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: When Nadva-tul-Ulema came into being?
questions.explanation: Note: Nadwat-ul-Ulema was founded at Kanpur in 1893 (formally organised 1894). Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: First session of All-India Muslim League was held on 29-30 December 1907. Where was it held?
questions.explanation: Answer: Karachi. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: “Few individuals significantly alter the source of history. Fewer still modify the map of the world. Hardly anyone can be created with creating a nation-state. Mohammad Ali Jinnah did all three”. Who made these remarks about Quaid-e-Azam?
questions.explanation: Answer: Stanley Wolpert. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: Where, during the War of Independence, was Sir Syed Ahmed Khan working/ posted?
questions.explanation: Answer: Bijnaur. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: Sir Syed Ahmed Khan established a Translation Society (later, renamed as ‘Scientific society’) in 1864. In which town was it founded?
questions.explanation: Answer: Ghazipur. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: In 1867, some prominent Hindus of Banares Launched a movement for the replacement of Urdu written in Nasta’leeq by Hindi written in Deva Nagiri script as the Court language. In which province(s) was this movement started?
questions.explanation: Answer: North-western Provinces. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: Which organization is considered the first Muslim political body continued to represent the Muslims of the subcontinent as a whole?
questions.explanation: Answer: Central National Mohammadan Association. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: Mention the importance announcement (s) that was/were made by the Governor General Lord Hardinge in thie Darbar at Delhi in 1911.

options.A: Annulment of the partition of Bengal
options.B: Transfer of Capital from Calcutta to Delhi

questions.explanation: Answer: Both of these. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: Faraizi Movemnents was primarily a religious movement. What change Dudhu Mian brought in the movement?

options.A: Transferred it into a guerrilla movement
options.B: Transferred it into a political movement
options.C: Transferred it into a Cultural movement

questions.explanation: Answer: Transferred it into a political movement. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: Which of the following was/were the drawback(s) of the government of Indian Act 1858?

options.A: Control of the Secretary of State for India and his council was bureaucratic in nature.
options.B: Expenses of the Secretary of State for India and his Council became a burden on Indian revenues.

questions.explanation: Low confidence: option-combination item carried from the CSS key. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: By how many member(s) the Executive Council of the Governor General was enlarged under the Indian Council Act of 1861?
